objectiveBindings.standingWorkOrder: Fly to Origin. Follow the audit-site approach and land.
objectiveBindings.realTransition: Exact state-conditioned copy under the existing ch13:return:origin travel objective and Origin · audit site label: while airborne, in transit or descending before a grounded Origin landing, use the signed base flight workOrder ["Fly to Origin.", "Follow the audit-site approach and land."]. At actual grounded Origin while the player still owns boarded flight controls, use ["Disembark.", "Follow the audit-site marker on foot."]. At actual grounded Origin with embodied on-foot controls before physical reach of W-7744, use ["Follow the audit-site marker on foot."]. These are silent same-ID standing-copy changes with no additional entry acknowledgement, score event, required input, objective or arrival credit. The existing destination authority resolves the actual Origin/audit-site target in the active world; on foot it must lead to the real W-7744 approach, never the hatch. Existing vehicle controls own landing/disembarkation; this text does not create a new disembark control. Desktop/mobile, reduced motion and every quality tier use these same phase meanings, exact state copy and destination. Pause/Continue/world handoff reconstruct the actual next action without regressing a grounded Origin arrival to mandatory board or lift. The existing arrival anchor commits once only after the actual Origin world, grounded flight/landing facts, embodied on-foot state and physical reach of W-7744 satisfy the return. World activation or landing alone does not clear the return objective, grant the milestone or open the survey. Keep return:origin active with its signed state-conditioned travel guidance through disembarkation and the real on-foot approach; then clear it and select the actual survey objective from its existing state. No flight-mode regression, elapsed time, rail progress or seeded receipt substitutes for physical arrival.

Follow his progress, or return to the last tested point to revise."]. After the actual approach ends, workOrder is the signed base testing workOrder. Both states use the exact neutral markerLabel W-7744 · offered route. The transition replaces standing text silently within the same ID; it does not re-enter the objective, repeat its acknowledgement, imply tested progress or change score. Existing revision/hold transitions and silent restore remain. Desktop/mobile, reduced motion and all quality tiers use these same states and words, with existing input-glyph substitutions only.
